item.title: [+1] 10-year G-Sec yield falls about 5 basis points to 7.39–7.40%, its sharpest drop since July
item.description:
Down from 7.44% as US Treasuries rallied after the Fed and crude eased slightly. Eases pressure after yields hit their highest since 2023 this week. Easing.

Real estate: mild tailwind (+1) — Funding relief

Why it matters: Lower yields cut borrowing costs and lift banks' bond portfolios; the relief may not last if oil climbs again.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) +1, Fiscal & trade balance +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days
